description:
## Goal
Retain the exact product-drive budget diagnostic without deep-copying every healthy waiting batch solely to remember last_wait. Share or move the already-owned wait data; preserve semantic scheduling and current observation ownership.

## Evidence
On baseline ad0ac47d3, src/compiler2/product_drive.rs:412 assigns last_wait = Some((current.clone(), waits.clone())) on every Waiting outcome before copying products into the flat expansion stack. PullWait and ProductKey derive Clone. Positioned product keys contain TransportPosition -> ExecutableSymbol -> ActivationSymbol.input: Box<[Ty]> (transport.rs:195-205,299+), so these are real deep copies, not just pointer increments. The copy exists even when no budget diagnostic is ever emitted.
Read-only baseline traces /tmp/fz-tfn24-after.n6luYj/{range,predicate,take-drop}.jsonl contain respectively 689/1742/3137 producer Waiting outcomes, all with nonempty batches. Counting the current product plus product waits with nonempty position.input in those outcomes identifies 1364/2953/7251 boxed input values containing 4739/7630/21649 Ty elements that would be copied if every such outcome reached last_wait. These are reported producer-outcome contents, not measured clone-site executions or allocator savings: validation-only waits are excluded, and accepted48 may cancel a pulled outcome before its Waiting arm reaches last_wait. Exact savings must be established at the actual drive seam, not inferred solely from product.evaluated totals. No active ticket specifically covered this clone; kdt.46 addresses fact wait discovery/arbitration, tfn.32 producer retries, and tfn.49 mutation-wave selection.

## Strategy
Start after fz-tfn.48 lands: its structured owner frames replace the flat stack, so inspect the actual resulting representation rather than porting a historical sketch. Determine whether the live frame and the last diagnostic observation can share one immutable batch or transfer ownership without duplicating keys. Prefer removing representation/copies over adding an allocation counter, parallel wait inventory, compatibility path, or new dependency authority. Do not make canonical/display strings semantic keys. If the .48 cutover naturally removes this exact cost, prove that and restrict this ticket to any remaining necessary deterministic regression proof and documentation, not a second implementation.

## Acceptance
TDD through the production drive seam. Preserve ProductDriveError::did_not_settle contract: the last observed product and full waits, even if that frame has completed before the budget ends. Keep exact String/fatal error formatting and real-drive budget controls (product_drive_test.rs:1796,2055+,2190+). Pin elimination of diagnostic-only positioned-key deep copies/backing storage duplication and account for any new shared allocation; no unmeasured claim that all allocations disappeared. Cover a multi-wait batch, ordinary/nested completion, failure/cancellation and a budget hit after the last frame drained. Preserve .48 exact observation cancellation and cumulative long-chain/wide-frame work controls, no obsolete requested events, unchanged/unrelated zero compiler work, original interp/native outputs, artifact bytes and healthy producer/job counts. Update relevant driver/performance docs; remove temporary probes and superseded ownership paths.

## Scope and workflow
Preexisting nonblocking epic tail, not permission to defer any .48-introduced copying or regression. Depends on .48 and blocks final cleanup .39. Implementation subagent, scoped cold adversarial review, one commit/close and CI-gated push as usual. Implementation is active under implement_tfn50; root owns index, commit, close and push.


## Active implementation boundary
Root selectively parked the complete unaccepted .46 candidate in immutable stash710cba048553f39fbfcb4eb49171b92cdb7809f7 (48 tracked plus failure.rs and measurement doc), verifying each blob and preserving all nine unrelated untracked files. Source is accepted .48 at e616d82d13cc4e916bfae8e5a48e5219ac680d8a. Type-ownership policy53 remains paused and is not a dependency of this ticket. Restore46 only after this cutover, reconciling its product_drive edits against the final50 representation.

Root rechecked draftPR118 atop wt/kdt-close, prior exact head e616 CI34019976927 SUCCESS, and all eight open cleanup PRs108/109/111/113-117. None changes product_drive/pull/ordered_worklist production code;111 touches pipeline documentation outside wait ownership. No PR transplant is required for this bounded ticket.

## Approved prototype and deterministic signal
Accepted48 product_drive.rs still clones owner and the complete sorted wait Vec into last_wait on every Waiting. Prototype: one independent immutable Rc wait batch owns the moved ProductKey and original Vec; the live frame and latest diagnostic share it. The existing semantic heap selects initial-batch indices or moved dynamic admissions. Selected keys are borrowed through cheap batch handles. No batch owner holds an ancestor-batch handle, so the latest diagnostic cannot retain an otherwise retired ancestor chain.

Make the ProductDriver pull seam borrow the key instead of consuming a clone merely for lookup. A borrowed child that itself waits copies its owner once into a new independent batch, replacing the baseline per-pull key copy; root and owned dynamic selections move, and unique completed frame owners move. Produced/Failed selections need no new key copy. Use one borrowed implementation, not parallel owned/borrowed drivers. Facts iterate the original prefix in reverse, removing drain/collect/reverse and avoiding new fact copies. Budget error hooks borrow the exact full owner/wait snapshot and retain their current formatting.

Accounting must distinguish removed deep copies from new storage: one Rc batch allocation and index/owned heap allocation for a nonempty product suffix; no per-wait Rc. Compared with prior original wait buffer, diagnostic cloned buffer and fact buffer, account separately for pure-product, fact-only and empty batches. Unchanged root hits allocate no wait frame or diagnostic storage. No total-allocation reduction is assumed from source shape alone.

Production-seam REDs must pin original wait Vec and positioned input backing at diagnostic/selection, exact latest snapshot after frame drain, multi-wait and nested ordinary completion, failure/cancellation release, dynamic smaller-key admissions, and no retained ancestor chain. Keep48 selected-owner no-extra-copy intent and all cumulative long-chain/wide-frame tests; explain representation-only assertion changes. Root approved this prototype, not final acceptance. Full healthy-work/artifact gates, documentation and fresh cold scoped review remain required.


## Accepted48 trace inventory
Root independently re-counted immutable accepted48 traces in /tmp/fz-tfn48-accepted-proof.kYZFpt. Reported producer Waiting batches are 689/1742/3137: fact-only51/122/194 and product-only638/1620/2943, with no empty/mixed producer batches in these three fixtures. Nonempty positioned owner inputs372/842/1856 and positioned wait inputs992/2111/5395 match the historical inventory. This informs representative storage cases only; cancellation and validation-only outcomes prevent claiming these are actual diagnostic-copy counts. Production-seam backing tests are the decisive signal.


## TDD baseline proof
/tmp/fz-tfn50-wait-backing-red.log, Cargo45179 terminal101, has three incumbent frame controls passing and two new production-drive seam controls failing on accepted48. budget_diagnostics_retain_the_original_wait_batch_even_after_its_frame_drains first verifies exact String text, then fails original Vec backing identity. healthy_wait_selection_borrows_the_original_positioned_input fails original boxed input identity at the pull seam. Budget cases1/4 cover a three-product frame before/after drain; existing no-owner-copy control remains. An initial test-helper mutability compile error was corrected before this genuine RED; no production code changed to produce the RED. Root inspected the test diff and terminal log. Approved representation implementation is now active; no green/acceptance claim yet.


## Prototype checkpoint
Root independently inspected /tmp/fz-tfn50-wait-backing-prototype.log: all five frame controls pass, including both original-backing REDs and incumbent48 owner-transfer/fact-order/cancellation cases. Source uses ProductWaitBatch, SelectedProduct and indexed-or-owned FrameProduct; ProductDriver::pull borrows through the standard Borrow argument, with one implementation. Error hooks borrow the complete snapshot; fact pumping consumes a cloned iterator over borrowed reverse-prefix entries, not cloned fact data. Intermediate canceled frames move only Rc handles, so discard does not copy overwritten boundary owners. This is a prototype checkpoint, not broad acceptance or a total-allocation claim.

Owner is adding actual ProductDriver producer-backing, nested lifetime/independent-owner, cancellation, empty/fact-only/mixed-batch controls and updating docs before full gates. Fresh reviewer creation reached the tool thread limit; cold_tfn48_acceptance, uninvolved in50 implementation, is performing an independent ticket-cold review against e616. Its prior48 acceptance is not50 acceptance; final source/evidence supplement remains required.
title: Eliminate diagnostic-only deep copies of product wait batches
